sourceFinding: game/game.mjs continueCampaign() falls through to restartCampaign() for any phase except between/failed. A stale hidden Next activation during playing therefore causes a full fresh restart.
proposedFix: Only call restartCampaign() from continueCampaign() when phase is complete; return false in other invalid phases. Keep explicit Fresh/R full restart.
